summary: Speechmatics advertises $100 in free speech-to-text signup credits valid for 12 months, no card required, with 55+ languages and 2 concurrent real-time sessions on Free. No-card Free API access pauses when credits run out. Adding a payment card upgrades Free to Pro: granted credits are consumed first, then further usage is billed to the card. Separately, its text-to-speech pricing offers the first 1 million characters free. Current public pricing does not establish that the $100 STT credit is a shared STT/TTS pool. This listing is awaiting curator verification; signup and inference have not been tested in this source check.
claim_steps: Sign up at https://portal.speechmatics.com/signup/ — the $100 STT offer states no card required.
Use the $100 STT signup bonus within 12 months; confirm the account's allowance and Free-tier limit of 2 concurrent real-time sessions.
For text-to-speech, check the separate first-1-million-characters-free allowance; do not assume it draws from the $100 STT credit.
Review current billing terms: no-card Free API access pauses at credit exhaustion. Adding a card upgrades Free to Pro; granted credits are consumed first, then further usage is billed to your card.

social_proof.title: Billing | Speechmatics Docs
social_proof.text: Adding a card upgrades a Free plan to Pro. ... Pro accounts pay through pay-as-you-go (PAYG): you keep a payment card on file, and usage draws down your granted credits first. Once your granted credits are used up, further usage is charged to your card on the first of each month for the previous month's usage.
